channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Walmart to roll out Apple Pay, other contactless payment options, at all US stores from Aug 24
item.description: The new payment methods will be integrated across all of Walmart's physical stores by the end of the year, as well as on its websites and mobile applications.

item.title: Trump's 50% Canada tariffs kick in: Whisky, alcohol, dairy, motorcycles and more affected | Check list
item.description: The latest US tariffs came into force at 12:01 am on Saturday, covering a broad range of Canadian products. The affected goods include alcoholic drinks, dairy products and hockey equipment, among several other items.

item.title: Panama-flagged cargo ship with mostly Chinese crew sinks off Odisha's Paradip coast
item.description: A Panama-flagged cargo ship carrying 24 crew members, most of them Chinese, sank about 240 nautical miles from Odisha’s Paradip coast. The Indian Coast Guard and Navy have launched a rescue operation, while nearby vessels have been alerted to assist.

item.title: Meghan Markle’s acting comeback? Duchess of Sussex in talks for The Gentlemen Season 3
item.description: Meghan Markle is in very early talks to join Netflix’s The Gentlemen Season 3, potentially marking a major return to scripted acting after years away from regular screen roles.

item.title: Canada to impose retaliatory tariffs on US goods from September 8; Carney vows 'dollar-for-dollar' response
item.description: Canada will impose retaliatory tariffs on US goods from September 8, Prime Minister Mark Carney said, after trade talks collapsed. Carney said the measures would be announced in the coming days and would match the new US tariffs dollar for dollar to protect Canadian workers and businesses.

item.title: Trump's 75-country immigration visa ban struck down by New York judge — ‘Contrary to law’
item.description: The Trump administration issued a policy to suspend visas for nationals of 75 countries it deemed likely to require public assistance in the United States.

item.title: PM Modi meets BJP’s new national team after party slams CWC over ‘Vande Mataram’ resolution
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Saturday joined the BJP’s newly appointed national office-bearers for a group photograph at the party headquarters in New Delhi, following a meeting in which the party adopted a resolution highlighting the honour and historical legacy of ‘Vande Mataram’.

item.title: Stalin announces major DMK overhaul with age caps, 2-term limits and focus on young blood
item.description: DMK chief M K Stalin has announced a major organisational overhaul after the party's poll setback, introducing age caps and mandatory two-term limits for posts. The party will also expand its organisational districts from 78 to 110 to strengthen grassroots mobilisation.

item.title: Karnataka cracks down on ‘analogue paneer’, bans manufacturing, sale for 1 year: Does it apply to frozen desserts?
item.description: Karnataka has banned the manufacture and sale of ‘analogue paneer’ being sold as ‘paneer’ for one year, citing public health. Authorities clarified that paneer must derive from milk, and substitutes cannot be marketed as such, following a government notification issued on August 17.

item.title: India approves 1,800 km of new LPG pipelines across 6 states with ₹7,000 crore investment to boost supply
item.description: The regulator has approved three major LPG pipeline projects spanning Telangana, Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Karnataka and Goa. The projects will be developed by state-run GAIL (India) Ltd, according to a PNGRB statement.

item.title: ‘No adverse weather’: Kochi airport accuses SpiceJet of misinformation; airline responds— It was ‘precautionary measure’
item.description: The airport said it had noted ongoing operational issues with SpiceJet affecting its international services, including those from Kochi, causing considerable inconvenience and uncertainty for passengers.

item.title: Why is Trump warming up to North Korea's Kim while turning up pressure on South Korea
item.description: Trump is seeking to revive diplomacy with Kim Jong Un while pressuring ally South Korea, reflecting his transactional approach to alliances and changing US priorities. Experts say North Korea’s stronger nuclear capabilities and ties with Russia and China could make a new summit harder.

item.title: Karnataka IAS officer Gyanendra Kumar goes missing amid KPSC row; last traced to Bengaluru airport
item.description: Karnataka IAS officer Gyanendra Kumar Gangwar has reportedly gone missing and has been unreachable since August 20. His movements were last traced to Bengaluru airport. The development comes amid a KPSC recruitment row, though no link has been confirmed.

item.title: Pune property owners, landlords, PG owners, alert! Do this or face police action; tenants must pay attention, too
item.description: Pune's registration department urges property owners to register leave and licence agreements to avoid police action, following the recent penalisation of 175 landlords.&nbsp;

item.title: Flood survivor elephant ‘Joymoti’ airlifted from Northeast to Vantara for treatment
item.description: The elephant suffered several injuries in the incident, including wounds on her forehead, right ear, the area above her tail, left inner thigh and abdomen. She also had a deep wound around her external genital area that had become infested with maggots.

item.title: 'Manan Mishra will remain president as long as...': BCI chief hits back at critics, refuses to resign
item.description: BCI chief Manan Kumar Mishra has refused to resign despite calls from co-chairman YR Sadasiva Reddy, rejecting allegations of financial and administrative irregularities. Mishra said he has the support of over two-thirds of BCI members and will remain chairman as long as lawyers want.

item.title: Harvard, NYU to come to India next year? Sergio Gor says top US universities ‘interested' amid ‘demand’: What he said
item.description: Several top American universities, including Harvard and NYU, are considering establishing campuses in India due to high demand from Indian students, according to US Ambassador Sergio Gor at a recent forum.

item.title: Ladakh channels 90 million litres of glacier melt daily to 12 villages: 'This successful model is just a blueprint'
item.description: Although Ladakh has significant glacier and snowmelt resources, many parts of the region continue to face shortages of water for farming.

item.title: Delhi records 1,777 H1N1 cases; health ministry lists symptoms to watch for as flu infections rise across India
item.description: Delhi has recorded 1,777 H1N1 cases this year, including 114 in a single day, as flu infections rise in several states. The Health Ministry has listed key symptoms such as fever, cough, sore throat, headache and body aches, urging people not to ignore persistent symptoms.

item.title: Iran announces ‘offensive’ war doctrine: What has Tehran prepared in retaliation against US? Army spokesman reveals
item.description: Iran's military doctrine is shifting from ‘defensive to offensive’, influenced by lessons from recent conflicts, Army spokesman Brig. Gen. Akraminia said. He also stated the army had prepared a plan to reward those who kill or capture US troops if American forces launch a ground incursion into Iran.

item.title: Scottie Scheffler is about to beat Tiger Woods’ $121 million career earnings, with a little help from Tiger himself
item.description: Scottie Scheffler is close to surpassing Tiger Woods as the PGA Tour's top money earner, trailing by just over $1 million. A strong performance at the BMW Championship could set a new record.

item.title: Keeping the UN afloat: Trump admin plans $725 million payment as global body battles funding crisis — will it help?
item.description: The Trump administration plans to pay $725 million to the UN, less than 20% of the over $4 billion Washington says it owes. Experts say the payment could help keep the UN running, as the organisation faces a severe funding crisis and cuts.

item.title: Lunar Eclipse 2026 date and time: Will this astronomical event be visible in India? More details here
item.description: Lunar Eclipse 2026 date and time: The upcoming partial lunar eclipse will not be visible in India but can be seen across North and South America and parts of Europe and Africa. Learn more about this celestial event here.

item.title: Amid CJP's 'School Thik Karo' campaign, govt audit reveals 611 Rajasthan schools without buildings
item.description: The revelation comes shortly after a team of the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP), led by its co-convenor Ashutosh Ranka, was attacked while travelling to inspect a government school in Bagru near Jaipur.

item.title: ‘My husband was made the scapegoat,’ wife of Indian captain held in Britain speaks out over Russia sanctions breach case
item.description: Arrested Indian merchant navy officer's wife alleged that her husband was made a ‘scapegoat’ as her husband awaits trial in Britain over Russia's shadow fleet.

item.title: Jaishankar to visit Russia on August 23-24, co-chair India-Russia inter-governmental commission
item.description: The visit is being undertaken at the invitation of Russian First Deputy Prime Minister Denis Manturov, the Ministry of External Affairs said.

item.title: Noida-based techie ‘strangled’, ‘beaten’ to death after dispute with wife over ‘medicine to child’; four arrested
item.description: The in-laws alleged that the attack was a part of a pre-planned conspiracy, claiming that Rekha had switched off all the CCTV cameras in the house before the incident.

item.title: CJP activist accuses Rajasthan Police of using ‘scare tactics', says 15 personnel deployed outside volunteer's home
item.description: A Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) activist on Saturday accused Rajasthan Police of resorting to ‘scare tactics’ after 15 police personnel were reportedly stationed outside a volunteer's home. His claims followed an alleged attack on a CJP delegation in Jaipur district.

item.title: Ladki Bahin Scheme: Maharashtra spent ₹9,605 crore on 9.2 million ineligible beneficiaries, reveals RTI
item.description: According to data obtained by the Hindustan Times through an RTI application, the Maharashtra government has disbursed ₹9,605 crore to 9.2 million individuals who were ineligible for the Ladki Bahin scheme until June 2026.

item.title: Bar Council co-chairman YR Sadasiva Reddy asks Manan Kumar Mishra to resign within 15 days: Here's why
item.description: Weeks after Bar Council of India (BCI) Chairman Manan Kumar Mishra sparked controversy with his remarks about 2026 NALSAR University graduates, BCI Co-Chairman YR Sadasiva Reddy on Saturday wrote to Mishra, seeking his resignation within 15 days, LiveLaw reported.

item.title: ‘I have to die’: Entire family of 3 wiped out over 19-year-old's iPhone demand as parents fail to move rigid teen
item.description: A 19-year-old jumped to death from Maharashtra's Khawadya Hill over iPhone demand as desperate pleas fail to move rigid teen. Entire family of 3 was wiped out in the fall from cliff.

item.title: Govt restricts manufacture, sale of fixed dose combinations two chemical compounds for children below 4 years
item.description: Govt restricts manufacture, sale of fixed dose combinations two chemical compounds for children below 4 years

item.title: How an artisan is trying to revive Kashmir's lost fur trade without killing wild animals
item.description: By repurposing discarded sheep pelts from Kashmir's meat economy, artisan Tahir Ahmad Kalwal is crafting sustainable luxury fur goods, though a lack of local processing infrastructure threatens to stall the sector’s ₹600-crore potential.

item.title: Varanasi bans boat connectivity across ghats as raging Ganga nears 71.26 metres danger mark
item.description: Varanasi officials are monitoring rising Ganga River levels which is nearing danger mark. Precautionary measures are being taken, including closing of ghats, shift in cremation sites and installation of flood relief camps.&nbsp;

item.title: Airport rule change: International flyers from India won’t need physical boarding pass from Sept 1, says report
item.description: The Bureau of Immigration, through the communication, asked airport and aviation stakeholders to sensitise their staff about the change, which will come into effect from Tuesday, September 1.
